text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, while out with Gran Alegria—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in the direction Gran Alegria pointed,
there was a crane game filled with plushies
modeled after Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~! They're so round and plump,
every single one of them is adorable, right~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
When I was little,
we had tons of Paka Pouchis at home too!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Papa and Mama used to buy those for me all the time as souvenirs!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Hugging it to sleep makes you so toasty warm~, it's 100 miles of pure happiness~!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: Gran and Paka Puchi, best friends forever~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gran Alegria hums a tune, reminiscing about the past.
As I watched over her, I found myself
wishing to make her happy...
choice_data_list: Then I'll get it for you today.
Then I'll get it for you today.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yaaay!
Well then, I'm counting on you~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
